name: ZTE nubia RedMagic 12 Pro+
highlights:
Released 2026, October 15
223g, 8.6mm thickness
Android 17, Redmagic OS 12
256GB/512GB/1TB storage, no card slot

BODY.Build: Glass front (Gorilla Glass 7i), aluminum frame, glass back (Gorilla Glass 7i)
BODY:
Pressure sensitive zones (700Hz touch-sensing)
Built-in cooling fan (IPX8 water resistant)
IP68/IP69 dust tight and water resistant (high pressure water jets; immersible up to 1.5m for 30 min)
Aviation aluminum middle frame

PLATFORM.Chipset: Qualcomm SM8975 Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 (2 nm)
PLATFORM.CPU: Octa-core (2x5.01 GHz Prime + 3x4.03 GHz Performance + 3x3.74 GHz Performance)

MAIN CAMERA.Dual:
50 MP, f/1.9, 23mm (wide), 1/1.55", 1.0µm, multi-directional PDAF, OIS
50 MP, f/2.0, 13mm (ultrawide), 1/2.88", 0.61µm, AF
Auxiliary lens

COMMS.USB: USB Type-C 3.2 Gen 2, OTG, accessory connector, DisplayPort

FEATURES.Sensors: Fingerprint (under display, ultrasonic), accelerometer, gyro, proximity, compass

MISC.Colors: Nightfreeze (Transparent Black), Subzero (Transparent Silver), Skyfrost (Blue Transparent)
